overview.about: The Valspar Championship is played on the Copperhead Course at Innisbrook near Tampa, one of Florida's toughest layouts. Its brutal three-hole closing stretch - the 'Snake Pit' - regularly decides the tournament and separates it from the state's easier resort courses.
overview.nextEvent: The next Valspar Championship is played at Innisbrook's Copperhead Course in Palm Harbor, Florida. Tree-lined and demanding, it plays far harder than a typical Florida stop, especially over the closing Snake Pit.
